content:
Returns a scan configuration for the vulnerability that you want to remediate.
Note: This endpoint does not create the remediation scan configuration. Use the response from this
endpoint as the request body for the Create scan config endpoint to create the remediation scan.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or the WAS.TOGGLE_WAS.USE  custom role privilege.
Additionally, requires the Can Edit [64] scan permission. See Roles and Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the vulnerability you want to remediate. You can use the Search
vulnerabilities endpoint or the Search vulnerabilities for scan endpoint to
determine the UUID of the vulnerability you want to remediate.
vuln_id
required
